title: CollabAtlas Tool Entry
description: Schema for validating tool entries in the CollabAtlas collaborative solutions knowledge platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the entry, lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

tagline.description: Short summary of the tool, max 200 characters.

domains.description: Domains or fields where this tool is applicable.

collaboration-types.description: Types of collaboration this tool supports.

scales.description: Scales at which this tool operates.

external_links.description: External links related to the tool.

related_entries.description: IDs of related entries in the atlas.

created.description: Date the entry was created (ISO 8601 date).

last_reviewed.description: Date the entry was last reviewed (ISO 8601 date).

contributors.description: List of contributors who authored or reviewed this entry.

website_url.description: Official website URL for the tool.

github_repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/repo form when the tool was enriched from GitHub.

visibility.description: Repository visibility reported by GitHub when available.

license.description: License under which the tool is distributed.

open_source.description: Whether the tool is open source.

supported_platforms.description: Platforms on which the tool is available.

source_services.description: External services used to enrich or import the tool metadata.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last automatic enrichment refresh.
